conf:
SecRuleEngine On
		SecDebugLog /Users/fzipitria/Workspace/OWASP/ModSecurity/tests/regression/server_root/logs/modsec_debug.log
		SecDebugLogLevel 5
        SecDefaultAction "phase:2,deny,status:403"
        SecRule ARGS:test "value" "id:500032"

SecRuleEngine On
		SecDebugLog /Users/fzipitria/Workspace/OWASP/ModSecurity/tests/regression/server_root/logs/modsec_debug.log
		SecDebugLogLevel 5
        SecDefaultAction "phase:2,pass"
        SecRule ARGS:test "value" "deny,status:403,id:500033"

SecRuleEngine On
		SecDebugLog /Users/fzipitria/Workspace/OWASP/ModSecurity/tests/regression/server_root/logs/modsec_debug.log
		SecDebugLogLevel 5
        SecDefaultAction "phase:2,log,noauditlog,pass,tag:foo"
        SecRule ARGS:test "value" "chain,phase:2,deny,status:403,id:500034"
        SecRule &ARGS "@eq 1" "chain,setenv:tx.foo=bar"
        SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "@streq GET"

debug.pattern:
Rule [0-9a-f]+: SecRule "ARGS:test" "\@rx value" "phase:2,log,noauditlog,tag:foo,chain,deny,status:403,id:500034"?
.*Rule [0-9a-f]+: SecRule "&ARGS" "\@eq 1" "chain,setenv:tx.foo=bar"?
.*Rule [0-9a-f]+: SecRule "REQUEST_METHOD" "\@streq GET"?
